title: Measure A / Provisions / Oversight / Support / Housing / Homelessness Programs
motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the Council instruct the Chief Legislative Analyst, with the assistance of the City Administrative Officer and Los Angeles Housing Department, to report on the provisions of Measure A and any related oversight processes that will support the City’s housing and homelessness programs and priorities.
